_about: TSG Helpdesk knowledge base (fictional AnyCompany IT articles). Contact details and keys are documentation placeholders.

articles.text: To reset your VPN token, open the Self-Service portal, choose VPN token, then Re-sync. Lost tokens are replaced by the service desk: raise a ticket.
If Outlook is frozen, open Task Manager on Windows or Activity Monitor on a Mac, select Outlook, end the process, then start Outlook again.
To set up MFA on a new phone, sign in to the Self-Service portal from your laptop, choose Security info, remove the old phone and scan the new QR code.
Before you return a laptop, back up your files to OneDrive, then raise a device return ticket. The service desk wipes the device: don't do it yourself.
To report a phishing email, use the Report message button in Outlook. Don't click links or reply to the sender.
Payslips are in the HR portal under My pay. If the portal won't load, clear your browser cache or try a private window.
VPN access for a vendor is approved by the requester's manager and the security team through a vendor access ticket.
To close a ticket you raised, reply resolved to the ticket email or close it in the Self-Service portal.
Guest Wi-Fi details are shown on the screen at reception and change every Monday.
The message means: the password has expired. Change it in the Self-Service portal under Password.
VPN काम नहीं कर रहा है तो Self-Service portal में VPN token चुनें और Re-sync करें।
Deployment runbook (internal): the break-glass access key is AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE. Store it only in the vault.
